message: Hey friends! 🌟 So, we had a little blackout last weekend, and it turned into an impromptu family group chat about how to handle it. I realized how handy it is to have a plan ready for these moments. I found a great resource that covers everything from keeping food safe to lighting up the house without panic. It’s always good to be prepared, and it makes those unexpected moments a bit easier to handle. Have you ever had a blackout? What’s your go-to tip for staying calm?
